bug_types.label: Concurrency
bug_types.description: Overlapping requests or jobs leave a wrong stored result or return a wrong response.

criteria.label: An acknowledged change is lost when requests overlap
criteria.description: Two overlapping requests both receive a success response, but at least one acknowledged change is missing from what was stored.
example_phrases: an acknowledged change is lost when requests overlap
a saved change disappears when two updates overlap

criteria.label: A success response reports data different from what was stored when requests overlap
criteria.description: Under overlapping requests, a success response returns data that differs from what was actually stored.
example_phrases: a success response reports data different from what was stored when requests overlap
the response shows a value that was not saved

bug_types.label: Date and time
bug_types.description: Dates, times or time zones are computed, compared or grouped incorrectly.

criteria.label: Results grouped by date or time use the wrong time zone
criteria.description: Results grouped by date or time are placed in buckets of a different time zone from the one requested or configured.
example_phrases: results grouped by date or time use the wrong time zone
daily totals use the wrong time zone
events are counted on the wrong day
